title: The Secret Life of Betelgeuse

scenes.text: Astronomers have been studying Betelgeuse's unique dimming patterns
The Hubble Space Telescope has captured stunning images of Betelgeuse's surface
Betelgeuse has a long-suspected stellar companion, recently confirmed by astronomers
Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: Betelgeuse, one of the brightest stars in the night sky, has been a subject of fascination for astronomers. Recent discoveries have shed light on its secret life. Follow for daily science!
